mapper.select: SELECT c.OBJECT_ID ,c.SEC_ID ,c.S_INFO_WINDCODE AS windCode ,c.S_INFO_OLDWINDCODE AS oldWindCode ,c.S_INFO_NEWWINDCODE AS newWindCode ,c.CHANGE_DATE FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondchangewindcode c WHERE c.CHANGE_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{scanDays}, NOW()), '%Y%m%d') AND c.S_INFO_OLDWINDCODE != c.S_INFO_NEWWINDCODE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ais_inv_ods.wind_cbondchangewindcode newer WHERE newer.SEC_ID = c.SEC_ID AND newer.CHANGE_DATE > c.CHANGE_DATE ) ORDER BY c.CHANGE_DATE ,c.SEC_ID
SELECT * FROM rrs_securityinfo WHERE sec_id = #{secId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE temp_security_code = #{oldCode} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE security_code = #{oldCode} AND status = 'updated' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM rrs_temp_security_code WHERE status = 'updated' AND oprt_source = 'job' AND LOCATE(#{eventKey}, memo) > 0
